content.short: arianee provides Digital Product Passports (DPPs) that enable exclusive services, simplify resales, and provide access to product history.
content.description: Arianee uses blockchain technology to transform how durable goods are engaged with, owned, and traced throughout their lifecycles. It issues Digital Product Passports (DPPs) that unlock exclusive services, simplify resales, and provide clear visibility into a product's journey and history. For brands, this strengthens customer relationships, supports sustainable product lifecycles, and improves transparency around provenance. For users, scanning a product's unique identifier reveals its verified data and unlocks associated benefits.
content.meta: arianee uses blockchain to improve engagement, ownership, and traceability of durable goods. Discover arianee and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
